_comment: Demo defaults for the LotLine UI. Parcels are identified by short map-block-lot PIN plus location/neighborhood as a cross-check; the app resolves them against the snapshot and ignores entries that do not match.

benezet.caption: Record-consistent screening example: no decision-changing conflict was found in the checked records. Not an acquisition recommendation; market demand and appraisal not evaluated.

centre.caption: Conflicting records: LotLine refuses to score through them.
